# Work-item status

A small Kanban ledger of **active** work only. Delivery order belongs in [plan.md](plan.md); completed evidence lives under `done/`.

| Work item | Area | State | Next action / blocker |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| — | — | — | — |

States: `Backlog`, `Ready`, `In Progress`, `In Review`, `Blocked`. A passed item moves into `done/<area>/` and is removed from this active table.

## Recently completed (optional, keep short)

- None.

Maintain a single row per open WI. Do not duplicate requirements, review reports or design decisions here. Keep at most a few recent completion pointers; Git and `done/` retain history.
